jyutping: m4 dong1 jat1 wui4 si6 gam3

english.note: Use this when the nonchalant attitude specifically shows that the person does not regard something as important.

examples.english: They kept singing nonchalantly after being scolded, as if it were no big deal.
examples.traditional: 佢畀人鬧完都唔當一回事咁，仲喺度唱歌。
